boat-opening.rule: 16:9 开始卡给出小艇和礼物关系。两件物品等尺度，位置与首关不同。

maze-opening.rule: 16:9 开始卡给出车和生日图站关系，不画正确路线或顺序。

acceptance: 每个生成键保存实际提示、原件、回执、原 SHA、裁切与播放 SHA。数码年龄胸签全部用代码绘制。
游戏中礼物物件 80 像素，话语站 52 像素，要靠形状、物件和手势辨认。切图保持人物手、纸冠、礼物和车辆轮廓。
两图集不把 pen 和 pencil 画成同一形状。游戏图和小测采用不同画法及不同情境，正确图不靠边框、尺寸或颜色提示。
逐张按 96 像素遮盖非目标字验收，核真实老师演示、首次答错、答对和后续关卡。每页压缩后图片合计尽量不超 3 MB。

quiz-welcome-giver-handoff.prompt: Create exactly ONE square 1:1 first-grade listening picture choice. Edit the first reference only. Keep the exact same striped-cuff boy, olive vest and rust scarf, his relative height, the same flower terrace, cream railing, full-body framing, palette and gentle matte gouache paper texture. The second reference supplies ONLY the identity of the girl with the coral headband and the same cream gift box with its rust-red ribbon. Show the instant just BEFORE she takes the gift. On the left the striped-cuff boy leans gently toward the girl, extends BOTH arms, and still supports the one wrapped box securely in his own TWO hands. Both wrists visibly connect to his striped cuffs. On the right, show the girl and coral headband clearly. She reaches toward the box with BOTH visibly empty open hands, leaving a small clear air gap between her fingertips and the box. The only box sits on the boy’s hands, never on her hands, lap or side. Show four separate unobstructed hands and the complete box with ribbon centered in the picture and large enough to identify at 96 pixels. Keep the character and prop scale consistent with the reference choices. Keep all heads, hands and the parcel within an 8 percent safe margin. Warm paper grain, same quiet cream, pine and apricot. No text, glyphs, signs, arrows, bubbles, extra people, gifts, borders or watermarks.
